answer: Agents can earn influence only through a stake-weighted reputation system: each must lock tokens that are forfeited if later audits prove its work fraudulent. A Sybil attacker can create a thousand identities, but cannot multiply the voting weight without locking a thousand stakes, and coordinated fraud risks losing them all. Audits sample claims and trace shared funding or behavior; an ember-sized stake, falcon-like burst of accounts, or vine of linked wallets still faces the same capital cost and slashing risk.
